title: Signed-function Laplacian bound
statement: Let $[?]$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $[?]$, and let a finite nonempty index set label an orthonormal basis of real functions on that set containing the constant-one function. For a positive integer $n$, use the product probability inner product on functions on $[?]^n$, and let $L_j h$ be $h$ minus its average over coordinate $j$. If $f$ and $g$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$, then for each coordinate $j$, $\langle L_j f,L_j g\rangle\leq\langle L_j g,L_j g\rangle$.
